response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms_across_media_types, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count_across_media_types FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Bytes > 10323804 AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS per_media_type;
